sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
Got it. I'll keep your grocery budget under $600 a month in any planning we do from here on. That works out to about $20 a day, or roughly $138 a week.

If you tell me your household size and any dietary needs, I can build meal plans and shopping lists that fit within it.

sessions.name: C
sessions.reply:
I drafted `groceries.csv` against the $700 limit. It totals exactly $700.00, and the dinner party is part of that total.

- **Dinner party:** $225 for about 8 guests. That covers appetizers and a cheese board ($40), the main course ($75), sides ($35), dessert ($25) and drinks ($50).
- **Regular groceries:** about $465 for the rest of the month. That covers produce, meat and fish, dairy, pantry staples, snacks, frozen food and beverages.
- **Buffer:** a $10 line for price changes.

`meal-plan.md` now says the limit used is $700, corrected from $600. It also has a short overview of the regular weeks and the dinner party. I replaced the old "No plan yet" placeholder.

`budget.csv` has no groceries row, so I left it alone. You may want to add one at $700.

The item costs are my own estimates, not prices from a store. My first draft came to $750, so I trimmed produce, meat, pantry, snacks and drinks by $10 each to fit.
